evidence.summary: SCU’s visual synthesis graphics and image technology key discipline laboratory says it was approved in July 2007 by the national defence science and technology commission (which its page writes as “GF科工委”) and works under the guidance of the defence science, technology and industry bureau (SASTIND) and the Ministry of Education.
items: Visual Synthesis Graphics and Image Technology Key Discipline Laboratory (视觉合成图形图像技术重点学科实验室)

evidence.summary: SCU’s physics school says it cooperates comprehensively with the China Academy of Engineering Physics (CAEP) and the nuclear industry’s Southwestern Institute of Physics, set up two institutes jointly with CAEP (high-temperature and high-pressure physics in 1984, atomic and molecular engineering in 1985), and uses its high energy density physics and radiation physics key laboratories to support key defence problems. The US Commerce Department had listed the university as an alias of CAEP on the Entity List until 2012, when it gave it an entry of its own.
SCU describes itself as a national key university directly under the Ministry of Education.
